text: Look out of the window. The sun is shining and there are no clouds at all. What is the weather like?
source: 小禾教研原创静态题库 · 样例编写
sourceScope: 小学四年级上册静态内容库 · 未人工逐题复核 · 教学有效性待教研验证
steps: 描述天气的句子用 It is 开头，后面接表示天气或气温的词。材料里 sun is shining、no clouds 说明是晴天。
晴天的天气词是 sunny。
答：It is sunny.
hint: 先在材料里圈出 sun、clouds、rain、snow、wind 这类线索词，再决定用哪个天气词。
alternative: 也可以说 It's sunny today. 用缩写 It's 并加上 today。

text: The ground is wet and small drops fall from the black clouds. What is the weather like?

steps: 地面 wet、空中有 drops 落下，说明正在下雨，要用 rainy 来形容。
rainy 表示多雨的。
答：It is rainy.
hint: 想一想地面上有没有水，天空中有没有水滴落下来。
alternative: 也可以说 It is raining. 用正在发生的动作表示下雨。

snowy 表示下雪的。
答：Snowy.
hint: 从 winter、cold、snow 这些线索词想一想。
alternative: 也可以答 It is snowy today. 把单词放进完整句子里。

text: It has rained for three days. The children cannot play outside. What can they do inside? Say one activity.
answer: They can read books in the library.
source: 小禾教研原创静态题库 · 样例编写
sourceScope: 小学四年级上册静态内容库 · 未人工逐题复核 · 教学有效性待教研验证
steps: 连续下雨不能出门，用 can 说出室内能做的活动。
读书是下雨天常见的室内活动。
答：They can read books in the library.
hint: 想一个在室内、不需要好天气的活动。
alternative: 也可以答 They can draw pictures at home.

text: Your family will visit your grandparents' farm in spring. The weather report says it will be warm and sunny. Say what your family can do there.
answer: We can plant flowers in the garden.
source: 小禾教研原创静态题库 · 样例编写
sourceScope: 小学四年级上册静态内容库 · 未人工逐题复核 · 教学有效性待教研验证
steps: 温暖晴朗的春天到农场，可以做户外的事，用 we 表示全家人。
在花园里种花是合适的安排。
答：We can plant flowers in the garden.
hint: 把季节、天气和农场三个线索连起来想活动。

text: It is going to rain this afternoon. The school sports meet is in the morning. Is that a good plan? Give a reason.
answer: Yes, it is a good plan because the rain will come in the afternoon.
source: 小禾教研原创静态题库 · 样例编写
sourceScope: 小学四年级上册静态内容库 · 未人工逐题复核 · 教学有效性待教研验证
steps: 先判断这个安排好不好，再用 because 把时间和天气对应起来。
运动会安排在上午，而下午才下雨，所以安排合理。
答：Yes, it is a good plan because the rain will come in the afternoon.
hint: 把活动的时间和下雨的时间分别找出来。
alternative: 也可以答 Yes, it is a good plan, because the sports meet is in the morning.

text: It is cold and snowy. You want to walk in the park for half an hour. What should you take? Say one thing.
answer: A warm coat and a scarf.
source: 小禾教研原创静态题库 · 样例编写
sourceScope: 小学四年级上册静态内容库 · 未人工逐题复核 · 教学有效性待教研验证
steps: 又冷又雪天出门要保暖，要说出该带的东西。
warm coat 和 scarf 都是保暖用品。
答：A warm coat and a scarf.
hint: 想一想冷天出门要穿什么、戴什么。
alternative: 也可以答 I should wear a warm coat and a hat.

text: After school, Class Two wants to clean the small garden near the playground. It is sunny and warm. Say why this is a good day to do it.
answer: It is a good day because it is sunny and warm.
source: 小禾教研原创静态题库 · 样例编写
sourceScope: 小学四年级上册静态内容库 · 未人工逐题复核 · 教学有效性待教研验证
steps: 要说出「这是个好日子」的理由，理由要用 because 引出天气。
晴天暖和，适合在户外劳动。
答：It is a good day because it is sunny and warm.
hint: 理由要和天气有关，说清楚为什么这个天气适合干活。
alternative: 也可以答 It is a good day, because the sun is shining and it is warm.

text: It is very hot today. Choose the better place for the PE class: the playground / the swimming pool. Give a reason.
answer: The swimming pool, because it is very hot today.
source: 小禾教研原创静态题库 · 样例编写
sourceScope: 小学四年级上册静态内容库 · 未人工逐题复核 · 教学有效性待教研验证
steps: 先在两个地点中选一个，再用 because 说明和天气有关的理由。
天气很热，去游泳池比在操场上跑步合适。
答：The swimming pool, because it is very hot today.
hint: 想一想很热的天气里，哪个地方更凉快。
alternative: 也可以答 We can have our PE class in the swimming pool, because it is very hot.
